title: Migrate saved reports
summary: Rewrites the old PowerShell-style COMMAND line of saved reports to the CLI style and lists every file it left alone, with the reason
intro: Read this when saved compare reports still carry -Target / -Project. migrate-reports changes only the COMMAND line (--target, --project), is optional because compare reads both styles, and never treats a left-alone file as an error.

help: Rewrite the COMMAND line of saved reports from the old style (-Target "T" -Project "P")
to the CLI style of 1.56 (--target "T" --project "P"); only that line changes. A folder is
searched with its subfolders; --project adds that project's snapshot folder. Lists what it
left alone and why (no COMMAND line, wrapped or mixed-style line, unknown argument, not a
report). Forms CSV / chart DOT carry no command line: reported current. compare reads both
styles, so this is optional. Exit 0 = done; 1 = missing path / unreadable file; 2 = usage.
